overview: Based on the published agenda, the Administrative Policy Committee and Village Board of Kronenwetter held a budget workshop scheduled to begin discussions on the 2027 budget. This was the first of what appears to be multiple budget workshops planned to review and shape the village's fiscal year 2027 spending plan.
committee: Administrative Policy Committee and Village Board

discussions.body: The committee and board were scheduled to discuss the village's 2027 budget during this first workshop session. This agenda item was set for discussion and possible action regarding the fiscal year 2027 spending plan and priorities.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled, with a 15-minute total period and three-minute individual time limit per speaker, at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion for extensions.
actionItems: Expected to discuss 2027 budget priorities and framework during Workshop Discussion #1
Scheduled to consider possible action items related to 2027 budget planning
title: Administrative Policy Committee and Village Board - Budget Workshop 1 - 2026-10-19
